title: Role redesign preview is built and served; core workflow verified before final cosmetic refinements
summary: The redesigned standalone preview now provides concise supplier and manager navigation, supplier funding/renewal dashboards, a shared SIM detail record with Overview/Renewal plan/Supply history/Activity, sample registration and assignment, recipient-versus-monitoring states, saved promo preferences, pause/resume review, schedule setup, supplier override reasons, catalog and spending settings, scoped history and CSV export. Fourteen offline model tests passed. The last completed full browser run passed the core workflow and all page layouts at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440px with no script errors or API/external requests. Subsequent small cosmetic changes improved mobile metric layout and made history names open details; their latest browser rerun output could not be recovered after the execution environment refreshed. The latest source and three bundled scripts parse successfully. The existing preview task was started on port 5175. Existing production theme source is reused, but production code and deployment are unchanged. All data/actions are synthetic; no live login, OTP, validation, purchase or automated fulfillment occurred.

evidence.description: Self-contained current interactive preview with API connections blocked by CSP.
